# Real files decoded through avkit's container.Reader (MP4 and Matroska) and
# compared picture by picture with ffmpeg -f framemd5. The files are not in this
# repository and are not named: only what describes them and the hash of the
# result. Each is the first 900 video packets of the file in decoding order,
# cut with `jvt clip` (stream copy). Taken 2026-11-07 with go.264 v1.12.0 plus
# the MMCO 5 / frame_num gap fix; ffmpeg matched on every picture.
#
# container codec size frames md5-of-the-per-picture-md5s (joined by newline)
